text: our lab has a mess of instrument exports. every time someone re-processes a plate reader or SEC-MALS run they save a new copy (final, final2, final_JT...) and last month nobody could say which version of the SEC-MALS data went into the figure for the kinase paper. I want one place that lists every dataset we have: name, instrument, who owns it, date, size, which version it's on and where it is in the pipeline (raw, cleaned, analysed, archived), plus tags for the project. I need to search it and filter by status and by tag. invent ~30 datasets from our instruments (plate reader, orbitrap, SEC-MALS, confocal, NMR, DLS) to start, owners as initials
make the columns sortable. and clicking a dataset should open its details on the side: all the metadata incl where it lives on labshare, and the list of versions with what changed in each one

I need to mark which version was used in a paper. only one version per dataset can be the paper one, and show it in the table too so I can see at a glance which datasets have a paper version (maybe a filter for just those). and somewhere to write which paper it was

notes box in the details, editable, and it has to stick when I reload the page. right now if I change a status and refresh it's gone. also give me a way to go back to the sample data while I'm testing
search doesnt find anything when I type a tag name or something I wrote in the notes, can it look in those too
we're archiving everything from the 2024 grant. can I tick a bunch of rows and change their status in one go? and export the table as csv for the PI, just the rows I'm looking at after filtering
